# MathUtils
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/math-utils/contracts/MathUtils.sol)

**Title:**
MathUtils

Utility library for mathematical operations


## Functions
### rpow

Calculates x^n with precision of base (typically 1e18)

Uses an optimized assembly implementation for efficiency

This function handles Percentage wrapped inputs and outputs

Is equivalent to exp(ln((rate))*(secondsSince))

Is derived from this function on MakerDAO's Pot.sol
https://github.com/makerdao/dss/blob/fa4f6630afb0624d04a003e920b0d71a00331d98/src/pot.sol#L85


```solidity
function rpow(Percentage wrappedX, uint256 n, Percentage wrappedBase) internal pure returns (Percentage result);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`wrappedX`|`Percentage`|The base number wrapped as Percentage|
|`n`|`uint256`|The exponent (not wrapped, treated as a whole number)|
|`wrappedBase`|`Percentage`|The precision factor (typically 1e18) wrapped as Percentage|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`result`|`Percentage`|The result of x^n, representing (x^n) * base, wrapped as Percentage|


### rpow

Calculates x^n with precision of base (typically 1e18)

This is an overloaded version that accepts and returns unwrapped uint256 values

Uses the same optimized assembly implementation as the wrapped version


```solidity
function rpow(uint256 x, uint256 n, uint256 base) internal pure returns (uint256 result);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`x`|`uint256`|The base number (unwrapped)|
|`n`|`uint256`|The exponent (treated as a whole number)|
|`base`|`uint256`|The precision factor (typically 1e18, unwrapped)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`result`|`uint256`|The result of x^n, representing (x^n) * base (unwrapped)|
